req.title: Player creation persists to DB
req.statement: The system shall commit newly created players to the players table so subsequent GET requests return them.

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-019 requires that POST /players/ commits a new player to the DB so a subsequent GET returns it. Tests must cover: (1) positive EP — valid new player returns 201 and GET confirms persistence; (2) negative NEG — duplicate squad_number returns 409 and is not double-inserted; (3) boundary BVA — squad_number at the boundary of existing data (27, one above the highest seeded value 26) is accepted and persisted; (4) STC — state transition from non-existent to persisted verified by GET /players/squadnumber/{n}; (5) DT — missing required field (firstName=null) returns 422 and nothing is persisted; (6) NEG — missing required field position returns 422. All tests use FastAPI TestClient in-process, assert exact status codes and exact payload fields drawn only from PlayerResponseModel and PlayerRequestModel attributes visible in source.

tests.name: test_post_player_persists_and_get_returns_201_then_200
preconditions: Squad number 99 does not exist in DB
actions: POST /players/ with a valid payload using squad_number=99
Assert POST response status is exactly 201
Assert response body contains all submitted fields plus a UUID id
Assert GET response status is exactly 200
Assert GET response body matches the created player
expected: Response JSON contains first_name, last_name, squad_number, position, id (UUID)
GET /players/squadnumber/99 returns HTTP 200 with matching payload
trace: R-PLAYER-019: newly created player committed to DB
R-PLAYER-019: subsequent GET returns the player
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_persists_and_get_returns_201_then_200():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Arjun",
        "lastName": "Verma",
        "squadNumber": 99,
        "position": "Goalkeeper",
        "middleName": None,
        "dateOfBirth": "2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z",
        "abbrPosition": "GK",
        "team": "Test FC",
        "league": "Premier League",
        "starting11": True
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert body["firstName"] == "Arjun"
    assert body["lastName"] == "Verma"
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert "id" in body
    assert body["id"] is not None
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/99")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 99
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Arjun"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Verma"
    assert get_body["position"] == "Goalkeeper"
    assert get_body["id"] == body["id"]

tests.name: test_post_player_state_transition_nonexistent_to_persisted
expected: Subsequent GET returns 200 with matching player data
trace: R-PLAYER-019: state transition from non-existent to persisted
tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_state_transition_nonexistent_to_persisted():
    pre_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert pre_r.status_code == 404
    payload = {
        "firstName": "Transition",
        "lastName": "Player",
        "squadNumber": 50,
        "position": "Centre-Back",
        "abbrPosition": "CB",
        "team": "State FC",
        "league": "Serie A",
        "starting11": False
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    assert post_r.headers.get("location") == "/players/squadnumber/50"
    post_body = post_r.json()
    assert post_body["squadNumber"] == 50
    get_r = client.get("/players/squadnumber/50")
    assert get_r.status_code == 200
    get_body = get_r.json()
    assert get_body["squadNumber"] == 50
    assert get_body["firstName"] == "Transition"
    assert get_body["lastName"] == "Player"
    assert get_body["id"] == post_body["id"]

tests.name: test_post_player_response_contains_uuid_id_field
actions: Assert response body contains 'id' field that is a valid UUID string
Assert id is not empty string
expected: Response JSON 'id' is a non-empty UUID string (36 chars with hyphens)
trace: R-PLAYER-019: created player has generated UUID persisted
tests.executable:
import uuid
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from main import app

client = TestClient(app)

def test_post_player_response_contains_uuid_id_field():
    payload = {
        "firstName": "UUID",
        "lastName": "Check",
        "squadNumber": 60,
        "position": "Central Midfield",
        "abbrPosition": "CM",
        "team": "UUID FC",
        "league": "Ligue 1",
        "starting11": True
    }
    post_r = client.post("/players/", json=payload)
    assert post_r.status_code == 201
    body = post_r.json()
    assert "id" in body
    player_id = body["id"]
    assert isinstance(player_id, str)
    assert len(player_id) == 36
    parsed = uuid.UUID(player_id)
    assert str(parsed) == player_id
    assert body["squadNumber"] == 60
    assert body["starting11"] == True
